name: shrinkage-trigger-vocabulary-recall-expansion
title: Expand claimsShrinkage trigger vocabulary recall: adverb insertion, inflections, shrinkage verbs, quoted nouns, and plus-lists verified out-of-scope during B-2c03
description: During B-2c03 (DONE 0.3.185), nine codex host-B cross-vendor review rounds plus claude-lane reviews verified five recall-gap classes in the claimsShrinkage trigger vocabulary of evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts), all live-verified against the built code with zero unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gaps emitted, and all excluded from B-2c03 by its user-confirmed scope boundary (vocabulary changes beyond the remaining decision were out of scope): (1) adverb insertion in multi-word triggers - The Windows install path is not yet covered by this delivery; (2) inflections - only partially delivered, This delivery excludes the admin workflow; (3) shrinkage VERBS carrying the claim when the trigger word sits inside a stripped-by-requirement token (file names like deferred-query.sql, backticked code spans) - was skipped, was removed, was dropped, left to a follow-up story; (4) quoted scope nouns - The remaining quoted-cases were left for a follow-up story (quote characters sit between the chain connector and the noun position); (5) rare list constructions - web, mobile, plus Safari cases (comma+plus is not in the Oxford branch). This story expands the vocabulary following B-2c03's established pattern: RED-first smoke cases in packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts in BOTH directions, each addition checked against the stripCodeLikeTokens sanitizer and the remaining-chain clause taxonomy for interaction bugs, respecting the clause-structure design and convergence statement documented in B-2c03's plan.md.
